name: Explosion + List Combination
summary: Combines an exploded 3D view of tightly packed cells with a linked list of cells, so users can find a cell in either and select it, with selections mirrored between the two.
howItWorks: The exploded view (with user-controlled spacing) and the list are shown together; clicking a cell in either highlights it in both, letting users traverse neighbours in the list and check them spatially in the 3D view. In a remote study with botanists' cell-division data (a 3D view operated with the mouse on a desktop), List and Explosion performed similarly for surface cells, List was better for traversing inner cells, and most participants preferred the Combination.
advantages: Most preferred: users could control cell distance and fall back on the list.

relationships.note: Adds a linked cell list to the exploded view.

review.notes: Coded from the GI 2021 full text.
